title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: OpenAI starts labeled visual ads inside ChatGPT image generation (US free tier, October)
bullets.summary: OpenAI says ads will be clearly labeled, limited to free-tier US users, and absent for Plus/Pro/Enterprise; it reports 1.2B weekly users.
bullets.how: Brand 9 Signs: a possible new paid-acquisition surface to test once self-serve opens. PRAGMA: ad-surface shift to brief clients on. The Construct: no direct use.

bullets.title: Google pauses its Open Source Vulnerability Rewards Program after a flood of AI-generated junk reports
bullets.summary: Human reviewers were overwhelmed separating real findings from automated noise; Google is redesigning the program, with updates expected in 2027.
bullets.how: The Construct: any agent that submits reports, PRs or leads externally needs a verification gate so we are not the noise. PRAGMA: concrete cautionary case for client agent-output QA.

bullets.title: Reflection AI plans an open-weight model release this month to compete with DeepSeek and Qwen
bullets.summary: No specs published yet; positioned as a US open-weight alternative.
bullets.how: The Construct: watch for a cheap self-hostable model for Hermes workers. PRAGMA: open-weight option for clients with data-residency needs.

bullets.title: Strata engine runs a 125B-parameter Qwen model on a 12GB consumer GPU at 44-124 tokens/sec
bullets.summary: Open-source engine using aggressive quantization and offloading to fit large models on small GPUs.
bullets.how: The Construct: could let local GPU nodes run bigger models for render/QA agents; verify quality loss from quantization first. PRAGMA: local-inference cost talking point.

bullets.title: OpenAI Codex/Work: Pro plan limits drop to Plus tier on Oct 30 amid a '28-day daily improvement' pledge
bullets.summary: An OpenAI lead pledged daily Codex/Work improvements for 28 days; plan limit changes take effect October 30.
bullets.how: Informational for now; revisit only if we depend on OpenAI Codex limits.

praxis_lesson: When AI output floods a channel, the channel closes: Google froze its OSS bug bounty over AI-generated junk. Every Construct agent that sends anything outward needs a verify-before-submit gate and a quality bar, or its volume becomes a liability.
